kevin: Heads up — after our IdP migration yesterday (Okta -> new Okta instance) our compliance team reports they cannot view audit logs for org org_3F2 from Console or API. Console shows "No logs available" despite actions today. Need this fixed ASAP for tomorrow's audit.

emma: @kevin sorry to hear that. Are you hitting the API or Console or both? Any 4xx/5xx responses you can paste? Also confirm whether you're using an org-admin token or a regular user token.

kevin: Both. Tried Console and curl with an org-admin token. Here's the API call I used:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_org_XXXX" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit_logs?org=org_3F2&limit=50"
```

Response was:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "entitlement_missing",
  "message": "audit_logs:read"
}
```

Console UI for a user who was previously an admin shows the retention toggle missing under Settings > Compliance.

deploy-bot: New support ticket created: #SUP-2026-4981  severity: high  reason: audit log access blocked for compliance

natalie: tagging infra & security. Initial hypothesis: IdP/SCIM mapping change dropped the groups field so entitlements weren't provisioned. Did you change any SCIM attributes or SAML assertion attribute names during migration?

kevin: Yes — we switched from sending `groups` to `appRoles` in SCIM per our IdP consultant. Old mapping sent `groups` which mapped to Redwood entitlements. We didn't update Redwood's SCIM mapping to accept `appRoles`.

sam-oncall: I checked entitlement records for org_3F2. No audit_logs:read entitlement present. Query:

```
GET /internal/entitlements?org=org_3F2
# audit_logs:read not returned
```

Also saw recent SCIM provisioning logs showing groups:0 updated count.

luis-eng: Repro steps on our side:
1) Provision user via SCIM with only `appRoles` attribute
2) SCIM sync doesn't populate entitlements because mapping expects `groups`
3) entitlement rows remain empty -> API returns 403 entitlement_missing

Workaround: we can apply a temporary entitlement grant via internal API for org_3F2 while customer fixes SCIM mapping. Will need approval & an expiry.

- open Console -> no retention toggle
- query entitlements -> missing audit_logs:read
